tier: Mac Mini M4, 16 GB / 256 GB, monthly

free_tier.stated: No free tier is published: the Mac Mini M4 with 16 GB RAM and 256 GB SSD is $99.00 per month before tax, with an hourly rate of $0.14 shown but a one-month minimum allocation. Free credits are offered only in exchange for a G2 review after subscribing to a plan.
free_tier.notes: The provider list's $0.14 an hour is the hourly rate printed on the pricing page; the $99 a month divided by 730 hours is $0.136 an hour. The M4 Pro is $199 a month and an M6 at $215 a month is marked Soon.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a dedicated Mac Mini, not an object; the base configuration has a 256 GB SSD with optional 1 TB or 2 TB storage

retention.stated: unverified: no data retention or deletion term for a released machine was stated on the pages read

egress.terms: 10 Gbps on all plans with a dedicated IPv4 address; the homepage says high bandwidth bursting to 1 GB/second. No data cap, free allowance or overage price is stated on the pages read.

interface_detail: remote control with VNC and SSH, plus a native Roundfleet Desktop Client for macOS, Windows and Linux; a support ticketing system is at app.roundfleet.com
tooling: an SSH client, a VNC viewer or the Roundfleet desktop client; the user installs and runs CI runner agents on the rented Mac. The Mac itself is the hosted offer.
chaining: the dedicated Apple silicon Mac runs GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or other runners and MLX-based model work, reached over SSH or VNC from any client; the one-month minimum makes it unsuitable for a short single job.

limits.value: $99.00 a month for the base M4; an hourly rate of $0.14 is shown but the minimum allocation is one month

limits_note: storage options are 1 TB for +$17 a month with a $10 setup fee and 2 TB for +$28 a month with an $8 setup fee; the M6 tier is listed as Soon with first units on 22 September 2026.
binding_note: the one-month minimum at $99 is the first limit a caller meets despite an hourly rate being printed; no request-rate or byte quota is stated.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the signup form was not read, so email is the assumed kind because an account is needed; the features page says 'Create your account and choose the subscription that fits your needs' and links to a contact form, and no registration form or payment rail was reachable on the pages read. Whether a phone number, card or identity document is asked for is unverified: behind a sign-up. The contact route asks the user to get in touch with the team.

reliability_note: unverified: no status page, uptime history or throttle policy was read; the pricing page marks the M6 tier as Soon with first units on 22 September 2026.
confidence_note: prices, storage options, access methods and the M6 status are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-25; the identity requirement was not on a page that could be read, so it stays unverified.
